items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Die Frist von zwei Wochen beginnt mit dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: Formal delivery (Zustellungsurkunde, §182 ZPO) documents actual delivery on Saturday 21.11.2026. Per §187(1) BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted; the two-week (14-day) Einspruch period runs from 21.11.2026 and, per the standard rule for weekly periods (§188(2) BGB), ends on the day two weeks later bearing the same name, i.e. Saturday 05.12.2026. Since that day is a Saturday, §193 BGB shifts the deadline to the next business day, Monday 07.12.2026 (no Brandenburg public holiday intervenes). So the Einspruch must reach the Zentraldienst der Polizei Muster-Brandenburg by 07.12.2026.

items.title: Pay total fine amount after legal force
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen nach Eintritt der Rechtskraft zu zahlen.
items.computation: Assuming no Einspruch is filed, the Bußgeldbescheid becomes legally final (Rechtskraft) on the day after the Einspruch deadline expires, i.e. 08.12.2026 (Tuesday). Applying the same two-week computation (§187(1), §188(2) BGB) from that date: the period starts the next day and ends two weeks after 08.12.2026 on the day of the same name, i.e. Tuesday 22.12.2026, which is not a weekend day or Brandenburg public holiday, so no shift under §193 BGB is needed. This date is contingent on no Einspruch being lodged by 07.12.2026; if Einspruch is filed, Rechtskraft (and this payment deadline) does not occur as calculated.

warnings: The sender's name and nearly every proper noun in this letter use obvious placeholder/template wording ("Muster-Brandenburg", "Musterblankenfelde", "Musterspree", "Beispielkow", "Musterfurt", "Landesmusterbank"), which is unusual for a genuine official fine notice — verify independently (e.g. via the official Brandenburg Zentrale Bußgeldstelle contact details) that this document and the IBAN DE70 1600 0000 0005 8312 00 are authentic before paying anything.

The 2-week Einspruch deadline is computed from the postal delivery date noted on the attached Zustellungsurkunde (21.11.2026); if the original envelope shows a different delivery date, the deadline must be recalculated.

The payment due date assumes the fine becomes legally final because no Einspruch is filed by 07.12.2026; if an Einspruch is submitted, this payment obligation does not apply as calculated and the case instead proceeds to court review.
